verdict.rationale: Supabase's first-party docs say it provides an open source AI toolkit built on Postgres and pgvector. They also say client libraries can store, index, and query vector embeddings at scale, and the homepage lists Vector embeddings as a core feature. The evidence is thin: short marketing-level quotes, with no detail on similarity-search operators, index types, or query examples. Missing for 10: detailed docs on similarity search and indexing (e.g., distance functions, HNSW/IVF indexes), and independent or hands-on corroboration of vector search performance.
